## Gateway Runtime Status and Remaining Gates

Gateway's ECL5#19 route is closed in native DOS and the canonical `?explore=gateway` browser route.
A genuine GameLink campaign arrived at `(15,2,W)`, presented descriptor 18's `FIGHT` / `LEAVE` choice,
fought Zhentil Fighter roster `4,3,4`, and resumed synchronously through host `CALL 0x401F` at the
tavern-sign cell `(9,9,N)`. Descriptor 122 then fought Griffon roster `42,3,42`; `[0x4C6C]=1`
persisted through an original-DOS save and cold silent reload. The browser regression covers the same
choice, combat/resume, second encounter, save, restart, and consumed-cell silence. ECL2#82 remains a
direct-combat smoke route only.

Gateway's ECL6 host also covers boat-abandon and NPC-gated exits, retail wandering encounters,
title-local MON6 rosters, the recovered WILDCOM/RANDCOM 50x25 floor, source placement, temporary
cloud/downed tiles, and exact resume. The remaining route boundary is the unobserved ECL2#1 entrance;
native RNG continuity and fixed-map placement origin remain narrower fidelity gaps.
Vision annotations remain advisory; retail bytes, GameLink cursor/RAM records, saved bytes, cold reload,
and automated engine/browser tests are authoritative.

## Claim Boundary

Gateway's selected ECL5#19 route is closed beyond static candidacy: a genuine GameLink campaign arrived at (15,2,W), presented the explicit player choice FIGHT/LEAVE, completed the Zhentil Fighter combat, resumed synchronously through host CALL 0x401F at (9,9,N), then completed descriptor 122's Griffon combat and persisted [0x4C6C]=1 through save/cold reload. The canonical Greybox browser route mirrors that cycle. The separate ECL2#82 route enters COMBAT directly and remains smoke evidence only. Gateway's ECL6 host now covers boat-abandon and NPC-gated exits, retail wandering encounters, title-local MON6 rosters, the recovered WILDCOM/RANDCOM floor, source placement, temporary cloud/downed tiles, and exact resume. Its remaining route boundary is the unobserved ECL2#1 entrance; native RNG continuity and fixed-map placement origin remain narrower fidelity gaps. Record sizes are decompressed archive facts; matching immediate instructions are linear-disassembly stride candidates, not semantic field consumers. The listed combat fields are separately proven by title-local source-to-runtime copy or direct-consumer instructions. The stored 32-bit character-experience field is distinct from the title-local kill-XP fields. The combat-award arithmetic, positive item-plus times 400 term, and living-party split are statically proven; the semantic names of the raw treasure globals remain provisional. Side-table keying and record boundaries are proven (Gateway SPC=9/ITM=63; Treasures SPC=9/ITM=17). Treasures race/category byte 0xAD has a title-local monster-code-6 consumer. Retail descriptor 18 copies each compact 17-byte item source record into canonical runtime item offsets 0x2E..0x3E, and every mapped field has a title-local consumer.
